messages:
Emma: Heads-up — we have the tenant_id type swap scheduled in the 00:00-01:00 UTC change window tonight. Need signoff on holdpoints + rollback plan.
Noah: looks good. Quick q: expected backfill row count for prod? last estimate was ~12M across 3 shards.
Raj: FYI DeployBot shows a 2-phase canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m holdpoints. Can we tighten the first hold to 15m for safety? :eyes:
DeployBot: scheduled deploy triggered by tag `release/2024-06-18-db-swap` at 00:05 UTC. Canary steps: 10% (00:05), 50% (00:20), 100% (00:35). Rollback window allowed until 01:05 UTC.
sre-oncall: replication lag baseline looks fine now (~200ms). We'll monitor; if lag spikes >2s we abort.
Emma: rollback triggers: 1) replication lag above 2s sustained >3m, 2) error rate >0.5% on writes to user_profile, 3) majority of canary shards failing healthcheck.
Noah: backfill plan — we run async streaming backfill with rate cap. Batch size 500, concurrency 8. Suggest reducing to 250 and concurrency 4 for first holdpoint.
Raj: ACK. Patch the deploy config to override batching for canary: `BATCH_SIZE=250 CONCURRENCY=4`. Also pin the app migrations to version `20240618-tenant-swap-v3` during rollout.
Emma: added to release notes: "DB: tenant_id type change — online convert + async backfill. Expect transient increased write latency; rollback safepoint at deploy tag"
Noah: escape hatch commands (tested on staging):
```
# quick rollback - revert schema pointer and stop backfill
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/db-migration db-migration=redwood/db-migrate:20240617-rollback
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/backfill/stop?job=tenant-id-swap
```
Raj: can we add a deploybot holdpoint at the DB lease handoff? I want a manual confirm before 50% step.
DeployBot: manual approval inserted at 00:18 UTC before 50% canary. Approval required from one of: Emma, Noah, sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: I'll watch the dashboards and be ready to approve/reject. If we reject, deploybot will rollback automatically. :thumbsup: 
Emma: final checklist: 1) feature flag in place for new tenant_id handling (rolled on at 50%), 2) pinned migration version in release tags, 3) reduced backfill throttle for canary, 4) rollback commands in runbook and on-call aware. Anything else?
Noah: add a DB stats query to post in thread every 5m during canary: `SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_meta WHERE converted = true;` — helps sanity check progress.
Raj: patch release notes with link to runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/tenant-swap (internal).
Emma: ok locking this thread. We'll reconvene on #incidents if anything weird. Good luck team. :rocket:
